definitions.explanation: Online platforms that allow users to create profiles, share content, and interact with others.

examples.japanese: SNS⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{繋|つな}がる→繋がる：01963_tsunagaru⟧。
examples.english: To connect with friends on social media.

examples.japanese: SNS⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投稿|とうこう}する→投稿する：18994_toukousuru⟧。
examples.english: To post photos on social media.

examples.japanese: SNS⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{使|つか}いすぎ→使いすぎ：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧する。
examples.english: To be careful not to overuse social media.

notes:
SNS stands for "Social Networking Service" and is the standard Japanese term for social media platforms. While English uses "social media" or "social networking," Japanese almost exclusively uses SNS.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- SNS⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{投稿|とうこう}する→投稿する：18994_toukousuru⟧: to post on social media
- SNS⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}する→更新する：27994_koushinsuru⟧: to update social media
- SNS⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{繋|つな}がる→繋がる：01963_tsunagaru⟧: to connect on social media
- SNS⟦{映|ば}え→映え：25470_bae⟧: looking good on social media (photogenic)
- SNS⟦{疲|づか}れ→疲れ：noentry⟧: social media fatigue

RELATED TERMS:
- ⟦{投稿|とうこう}→投稿：04733_toukou⟧: post/posting
- フォロー/フォロワー: follow/follower
- ⟦{炎上|えんじょう}→炎上：05867_enjou⟧: going viral negatively, online firestorm
- ⟦いいね→いいね：05865_iine⟧: like (button/reaction)
- バズる: to go viral

NOTE:
SNS is a Japanese-English coinage (⟦{和製英語|わせいえいご}→和製英語：18947_waseieigo⟧). English speakers may not understand it — use "social media" when speaking English.
